message:
b12x: load every KDA verification token before the recurrence

The verification kernel read each window token's query, key, gate, value
and beta from global memory inside the token loop, normalized query and key
with one warp, and synchronized twice per token, so eight speculative tokens
paid eight dependent global-load chains. The prologue now loads and
normalizes every token of the window into shared memory with all warps and
keeps values and betas in registers; the recurrence then reads only shared
memory and registers, without synchronization.

Each element keeps its lanes, reductions and operation order, so outputs,
corrections and key/gate records are bitwise identical. Six Kimi-K3 value
heads, eight tokens, RTX PRO 6000: 10.62 -> 7.69 us (block_v 16) and
11.68 -> 7.24 us (block_v 32); one token 2.48 -> 2.67 us.
